- Non-blocking, `packages/integrations/claude/dist/agents/holyagent.md:56` and `packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/search.md:3`: "with an open stdin and no path, rg searches stdin and reports no matches" gives the wrong mechanism. From ripgrep's stdin heuristic (from source knowledge, not run here), rg reads stdin only when it is a regular file, FIFO or socket. An open pipe blocks until EOF; an empty or closed one reports no matches. Fix: "With no path and stdin as a pipe or file, rg reads stdin instead of the working directory, so pass the path (for example `.`)." The rule stands; the reason is imprecise and applies to rg, not fd.
- Non-blocking, `root/search.md:3` and `specialist/working.md:4`: the sentence "not with grep, find or the Grep and Glob tools" is followed by "use the system rg, fd, grep or find".
